body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> SONORO showcased its internet/FM radio 'elements W' at CES 2009.

This internet/FM radio alarm clock and iPod/MP3 player with OLED display brings over 10,000 stations from around the world within immediate reach. Connect it to a LAN line or through WiFi and choose a station by country or by genre: jazz, classic, rock, and many others.
